evidence: Changes orphan handling and resource accounting in `src/node/txorphanage.cpp` and `src/node/txdownloadman_impl.cpp`.
rationale: Prevents remote memory exhaustion DoS attacks where peers bypass orphanage memory limits. Using transaction weight as a proxy for memory allows standard-weight orphans with many tiny witness elements to consume 11.1MB each (28 times accounted weight), enabling attackers to exhaust node memory.
